content: Ken Evoy, born on September 25, 1953, is the founder and CEO of SiteSell Inc. He was previously one of Canada’s most prolific toy creators during the 1990s. His game design company, Isovoy Inc., named as a combination of his and his wife’s surnames, developed and licensed over 20 toy creations between 1985 and 1998. In 1979, he established SiteSell Inc., a company that designs and develops a hosted web business-building system called Site Build It. (SBI.). With over 20,000 subscribers, Evoy leverages his expertise in internet marketing to assist small businesses in achieving success online. His contributions to the online marketing industry have popularized terms such as monetization, keyword, and preselling. According to Evoy, preselling is not about aggressively selling a product but about establishing oneself as an expert in the eyes of visitors by providing valuable information. Ken Evoy was born in Montreal to Grant Evoy and Simone (née Rioux). He grew up in the Montreal area and attended Loyola High School in Montreal. He pursued his studies in anatomy at McGill University, graduating with First Class Honors. He then entered the field of medicine at McGill University in 1975 and completed his internship in 1980. Dr. Evoy practiced as an emergency physician from 1980 to 1990. Alongside Dr. Marc Afilalo and Dr. Ivan Steiner, he was instrumental in hiring and training 200 physicians in pre-hospital emergency care for Montreal’s newly established EMS system, Corporation des Urgences Santé du Montréal Métropolitain, commonly known as Urgences Santé. He later worked as a full-time emergency physician at Hôpital du Sacré-Coeur de Montréal and the Jewish General Hospital.
